from math import hypot


def components(grid, bg):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen, out = set(), []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color, cells = grid[r][c], set()
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.add((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p = (y+dy, x+dx)
                    if 0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color:
                        seen.add(p); q.append(p)
            out.append((color, cells))
    return out


def elbow(cells):
    if len(cells) < 3: return None
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
    for p, d1, d2 in [((r0,c0),(0,1),(1,0)), ((r0,c1),(0,-1),(1,0)),
                       ((r1,c0),(0,1),(-1,0)), ((r1,c1),(0,-1),(-1,0))]:
        r,c=p
        a={(r+k*d1[0],c+k*d1[1]) for k in range((r1-r0 if d1[0] else c1-c0)+1)}
        b={(r+k*d2[0],c+k*d2[1]) for k in range((r1-r0 if d2[0] else c1-c0)+1)}
        if cells == a|b: return p,d1,d2
    return None


def transform(grid):
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps = components(grid, bg)
    markers = [(color,cells,elbow(cells)) for color,cells in comps if elbow(cells)]
    if not markers: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color, mark, info = markers[0]
    (er,ec),d1,d2 = info
    # The corner's unoccupied external quadrant indicates the object to recolor.
    sy, sx = -d1[1], -d2[0]  # signs corresponding to outside of the two arms
    candidates=[]
    for col,cells in comps:
        if cells == mark: continue
        cy=sum(r for r,c in cells)/len(cells); cx=sum(c for r,c in cells)/len(cells)
        if (cy-er)*sy > 0 and (cx-ec)*sx > 0:
            dist=min(hypot(r-er,c-ec) for r,c in cells)
            candidates.append((dist,col,cells))
    if not candidates: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _,_,target=min(candidates,key=lambda x:x[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in target: out[r][c]=color
    return out

def _components(grid, bg):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen, result = set(), []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color, cells = grid[r][c], set()
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.add((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p = (y+dy, x+dx)
                    if 0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color:
                        seen.add(p); q.append(p)
            result.append((color, cells))
    return result


def _l(cells):
    if len(cells) < 3: return None
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in cells),max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)
    for (r,c),d1,d2 in [((r0,c0),(0,1),(1,0)),((r0,c1),(0,-1),(1,0)),
                         ((r1,c0),(0,1),(-1,0)),((r1,c1),(0,-1),(-1,0))]:
        a={(r+k*d1[0],c+k*d1[1]) for k in range((r1-r0 if d1[0] else c1-c0)+1)}
        b={(r+k*d2[0],c+k*d2[1]) for k in range((r1-r0 if d2[0] else c1-c0)+1)}
        if cells == a|b: return (r,c),d1,d2
    return None


def transform(grid):
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=_components(grid,bg)
    ls=[(color,cells,_l(cells)) for color,cells in comps if _l(cells)]
    if not ls: return [row[:] for row in grid]

    # object in the quadrant opposite its two arms to the marker's color.
    color, marker, (corner,d1,d2)=max(ls,key=lambda x:len(x[1]))
    er,ec=corner

    sx=-d1[1] if d1[1] else -d2[1]

    target=min(candidates,key=lambda x:x[0])[1]
